results.name: build_player_action_update
results.evidence: Computes a facing vector from two angle params via sin/cos, packs an 8-dword payload with hash_table_get-resolved target index into a per-slot record (idx*0x200+base), then builds/sends network message 0x25 via FUN_004ec940 and iterates data_iterator_next broadcasting to peers whose per-player flag bits 1&2 are set via FUN_004e1930; called as the fallback path from FUN_004e7b50.
results.summary: Builds and rate-limit-caches a message-0x25 update (an orientation/action payload) for a player slot and broadcasts it to eligible connected peers.

results.name: build_remote_player_vehicle_dispatch_update
results.evidence: Resolves an object via object_try_and_get() at slot offset 0xf4, branches on *(iVar3+0x11c)==-1 to call FUN_004e84d0 (msg 0x29) vs FUN_00477210-gated FUN_004e86f0 (msg 0x2a), each of which shares the exact 0x68-0x94 matrix4x3 field layout used by build_local_player_vehicle_update; falls back to FUN_004e7890 (msg 0x25) on failure.
results.summary: Dispatches a vehicle/attached-object transform update for a given player slot to one of two message builders depending on the object's seat/attachment state, sending the result to matching peers.

results.name: build_player_full_resync_update
results.evidence: Unconditionally rebuilds and sends three cached message types (0x25, 0x27, 0x28) for one target (resolved via hash_table_get on unaff_EBX) using the same FUN_004ec940/FUN_004e1930 send pattern as the other build_* update functions, without the rate-limit checks those use.
results.summary: Flushes the current cached state of three network message types to a single target machine, likely used to resync a newly joined client.

results.name: network_player_update_history_log_write
results.evidence: vsprintf's the given printf-style format/args into a local buffer, and when DAT_00710320 (a debug flag) is set, appends it to "ServerPlayerUpdateHistory.log"; called by build_local_player_position_update and build_local_player_vehicle_update with strings "[%d]: [%d]:\t Acked [%d]\n" / "...Acked vehicle...".
results.summary: Debug logger that appends a formatted line to ServerPlayerUpdateHistory.log when the corresponding debug flag is enabled.

results.name: network_event_feed_queue_append
results.evidence: Appends two dwords plus a 12-dword record into a fixed-size (0x10 slot) ring buffer at in_EAX, incrementing a count at in_EAX+4 and calling FUN_004e8040 to flush once the buffer reaches 16 entries.
results.summary: Queues one event record into a 16-slot buffer and triggers a flush of the buffer once it fills.

results.name: network_event_feed_queue_flush
results.evidence: Iterates the queued records built by FUN_004e7ff0, resolves each entry's unit index through the DAT_0087a480 unit table and an inlined hash-bucket lookup on PTR_DAT_00687558 (the same open-addressing pattern used by hash_table_get), then sends the resolved indices as network message 0x26 via FUN_004ec940 and flushes via FUN_004e1a80.
results.summary: Resolves queued unit-index event records to network indices and sends them as a batched message-0x26 update, then clears the queue.

results.name: build_local_player_position_update
results.evidence: Existing non-FUN_ name matches the code: reads/writes an ack-rate-limited position record (fields at 0xe8/0xec/0xf0/0xf4/0xf8-0x100), calls FUN_004ec940 to build message 0x23, and logs via FUN_004e7f90 with format "[%d]: [%d]:\t Acked [%d]\n".
results.summary: Builds a rate-limited local-player position acknowledgement message (type 0x23) and logs the ack.

results.name: build_local_player_vehicle_update
results.evidence: Existing non-FUN_ name matches the code: resolves the ridden vehicle via a unit-index table plus hash_table_get, copies its 12-float (matrix4x3-shaped) transform at offsets 0x68-0x94, rate-limits via DAT_00689488, builds message 0x24 via FUN_004ec940, and logs "[%d]: [%d]:\t Acked vehicle [%d]\n".
results.summary: Builds a rate-limited local-player vehicle transform acknowledgement message (type 0x24) and logs the ack.

results.name: build_remote_player_vehicle_update
results.evidence: Same forward-vector-from-angles computation, hash_table_get target resolution, and 0x120/0x124/0x128/0x130 ack-cache layout as build_local_player_vehicle_update, but built as a reusable helper (explicit param_1 record pointer, param_4 fresh/resend flag) that calls FUN_004ec940 with message id 0x29.
results.summary: Builds or resends a cached vehicle-transform update (message 0x29) for a given object record.

results.name: build_remote_player_vehicle_gunner_update
results.evidence: Near-duplicate of FUN_004e84d0 (same angle-to-vector math, same 0x160/0x164-0x180 ack-cache fields, same hash_table_get lookup of a secondary object at unaff/param_1+0x34) but builds message id 0x2a instead of 0x29, suggesting a second vehicle attachment slot (e.g. gunner/turret).
results.summary: Builds or resends a cached secondary vehicle-attachment transform update (message 0x2a) for a given object record.

results.name: message_delta_array_field_decode
results.evidence: For each of the *piVar1 array elements, either unconditionally calls the per-element decode callback at (vtable+0x54) when param_2==0, or reads a bit and conditionally copies the previous element's bytes vs. calling the same vtable+0x54 decode callback, matching the encode counterpart FUN_004e95e0 which uses vtable+0x50 and bit_stream_write_bit.
results.summary: Generic array-of-structures field decoder used by the message-delta system: for each element either copies the unchanged previous value or invokes the element type's decode function.

results.name: message_delta_array_field_encode
results.evidence: Mirror of FUN_004e9330: for each array element calls the per-element encode callback at (vtable+0x50), writes a 'changed' bit via bit_stream_write_bit based on whether the callback returned >0 bits written, and accumulates total bits.
results.summary: Generic array-of-structures field encoder used by the message-delta system: encodes each element and writes a per-element changed flag.

results.name: network_index_cache_allocate
results.evidence: Performs an inlined hash-bucket lookup (modulo piVar1[4], chained via piVar2[2]) to find an existing slot for param_1; if absent, scans a rotating cursor (piVar1[9]) over a fixed slot array (piVar1[10]) for a free (-1) entry and calls hash_table_set_or_remove to bind it.
results.summary: Looks up or allocates a free slot in a fixed-size hash-indexed table, evicting via a rotating cursor when no existing entry matches.

results.name: network_index_cache_insert_if_absent
results.evidence: Checks a slot at (base+0x28)+param_1*4 for -1, and if hash_table_get() also reports no existing mapping, stores extraout_ECX into the slot and calls hash_table_set_or_remove(param_1) to bind it.
results.summary: Inserts a value into an index-cache slot only if that slot is not already occupied and no existing hash mapping exists.

results.name: network_index_cache_lookup
results.evidence: Trivial wrapper: returns hash_table_get() when the implicit key register (in_ECX) is not -1, else 0.
results.summary: Thin guarded wrapper around hash_table_get that treats a -1 key as 'no entry'.

results.name: network_index_cache_remove
results.evidence: Performs the same inlined hash-bucket chain lookup as FUN_004e9c20 for unaff_ESI; on a match, clears the mapped slot to -1 and calls hash_table_set_or_remove(0xffffffff) to unbind it.
results.summary: Removes an entry from the index-cache hash table if present, clearing its bound slot.

results.name: message_delta_float_array_encode
results.evidence: For param_2==0 writes a fixed 0x20-bit chunked value per element via bit_stream_write_bits; otherwise compares each float against the previous value with a 0.0001 epsilon, writes a changed-bit via bit_stream_write_bit, and calls FUN_004cf8f0 to encode the full 32-bit value when changed.
results.summary: Encodes an array of floats as per-element changed-bits plus full 32-bit values for entries that changed beyond an epsilon threshold.

results.name: message_delta_dword_array_decode
results.evidence: For param_2==0 decodes every element via FUN_004cf950; otherwise reads a per-element bit via bit_stream_read_bit and either copies the previous dword or calls FUN_004cf950 to decode a fresh value, mirroring the encode logic in FUN_004e9db0.
results.summary: Decode counterpart for a delta-encoded array of 4-byte values: copies unchanged elements or decodes changed ones.

results.name: message_delta_quantize_float_to_int
results.evidence: Computes fVar1*(param_1-param_2)/(param_3-param_2)+0.5, rounds via FUN_00623e40/FUN_006391b4, and clamps the result to [0, unaff_ESI], the same quantize-into-N-levels idiom used inline in FUN_004eabe0.
results.summary: Quantizes a float value within [param_2,param_3] into a clamped integer index with unaff_ESI representing the maximum level.

results.name: vector3d_from_yaw_pitch
results.evidence: Computes sin/cos of two angle parameters, snaps near-zero results to exactly 0.0 within a 0.0001 epsilon, and writes a 3-float unit vector (x=cos*sin, y=sin*sin, z=cos) to the pointer in in_ECX -- the same forward-vector construction inlined in FUN_004e7890/FUN_004e84d0/FUN_004e86f0.
results.summary: Converts a yaw/pitch angle pair into a normalized 3D direction vector, snapping near-zero axis components to zero.

results.name: message_delta_encode_vector3d
results.evidence: Computes a delta vector between param_2 and param_3, skips encoding when its length is below DAT_0069a2d8, otherwise writes per-axis sign/changed bits and quantizes each axis via FUN_00623e40/FUN_006391b4 with bit widths taken from DAT_0069a2d0/DAT_0069a2cc/DAT_0069a2dc, falling back to absolute-position quantization in a -5000..range when the delta path is unavailable.
results.summary: Delta-encodes a 3D vector as either a small quantized offset from a previous value or a full quantized absolute position.

results.name: vector3d_lerp_by_ratio
results.evidence: Computes out[i] = (in[1][i]-in[0][i])*(ratio[i]/denom[i]) + in[0][i] for each axis, selecting the denominator field (in_EAX[5] vs in_EAX[3]) based on DAT_0069b350 mode.
results.summary: Linearly interpolates a 3D point between two endpoints using per-axis integer ratios, with the denominator field chosen by a mode flag.

results.name: message_delta_quantize_vector3d
results.evidence: Calls message_delta_quantize_float_to_int (FUN_004ea480) three times, once per axis of param_1, storing results into unaff_EBX[0..2]; the DAT_0069b350-based branch is dead code (both arms are identical).
results.summary: Quantizes each axis of a 3D vector into an integer index using the shared float-quantization helper.

results.name: message_delta_quantize_vector3d_table
results.evidence: Validates a table header (NaN checks, default bit-range fields at pfVar1[3]/[5] derived from 1<<count-1) then iterates entries calling FUN_004eb4a0 to quantize each vector3 until a NaN sentinel or the count field pfVar1[6] is exhausted.
results.summary: Initializes and quantizes a table of 3D points (e.g. waypoints), stopping at a NaN sentinel or the table's element count.

results.name: message_delta_decode_vector3d_or_index
results.evidence: When param_2!=0 decodes 3 raw values via FUN_004cf950 and interpolates via FUN_004eb370 (vector3d_lerp_by_ratio); otherwise reads bits selecting a matching precomputed table entry (base+0x1c+index*0xc) and falls back to the raw-decode-and-interpolate path if no index matches, returning accumulated bit counts.
results.summary: Decodes a 3D vector either as an index into a precomputed table or, on failure, as raw interpolated components.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_free_registered
results.evidence: When DAT_0071cfa8 is set, iterates DAT_0071cfb0 entries of the registered-parameter array (&DAT_006b86c0, stride 3) calling GlobalFree on each name pointer and resetting the count to 0.
results.summary: Frees all GlobalAlloc'd names in the dynamic-parameters registration table and clears the registration count.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_reload_from_config_file
results.evidence: Matches naming-hint evidence (strings ['parameters.cfg']): when DAT_0071cfa8 is set, opens "parameters.cfg", reads its entire contents via fseek/ftell/fread into the DAT_00860b40 buffer, null-terminates it, and closes the file.
results.summary: Loads the full contents of parameters.cfg into the shared config text buffer for later parsing.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_register
results.evidence: Builds a qualified "scope::name" string via GlobalAlloc/__strdup when DAT_0071cfa8 is set, checks for a duplicate via FUN_004ec110, appends {name, type, value} to the DAT_006b86c0 array (bumping DAT_0071cfb0), and looks up an initial value from the loaded config buffer via FUN_004ec0d0 using an int or float format string.
results.summary: Registers a named dynamic tunable parameter (int or float) and initializes it from the previously loaded parameters.cfg text.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_send_update
results.evidence: When enabled, sets a sending flag (DAT_0071cfb4), advances a 2-bit sequence counter, calls FUN_004ec050 (format registered values) and FUN_004ec1a0 (pack values), builds message 0x22 via FUN_004ec940, and on success sends it via FUN_004e19c0, updating the last-sent sequence on success.
results.summary: Builds and broadcasts a network message carrying the current dynamic-parameter values, advancing a rolling sequence number.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_receive_update
results.evidence: When enabled, branches on a flag at *in_EAX: calls FUN_004ec590 (a widely-used message-delta struct-field decoder) and on success formats the decoded values via FUN_004ec230 and stores the sequence into DAT_0071cfac, or otherwise calls FUN_004ec670 for an alternate decode path.
results.summary: Handles an incoming dynamic-parameters protocol message, decoding and applying the transmitted values.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_format_registered_values
results.evidence: Iterates the DAT_0071cfb0 registered-parameter entries and sprintf's each as "%s %d\n" or "%s %f\n" (chosen by the entry's type flag) into the shared DAT_00860b40 text buffer.
results.summary: Serializes all registered dynamic parameters' current name/value pairs into a text buffer.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_parse_value_from_config
results.evidence: Uses FUN_00625430 (substring search) on DAT_00860b40 to find a matching entry and then on DAT_00660788, and sscanf's the value following it into param_2 using the caller-supplied format param_1.
results.summary: Looks up a parameter's text value in the loaded config buffer and scans it into an output variable with a given format.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_find_registered
results.evidence: Linearly scans the DAT_006b86c0 registered-parameter array comparing each entry's name string (2-bytes-at-a-time) against param_1, returning 1 and optionally the associated value pointer via param_2 on a match.
results.summary: Finds a registered dynamic parameter by name and optionally returns its stored value pointer.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_pack_values
results.evidence: Copies each registered entry's dereferenced value (DAT_006b86c8 array of value pointers) into a contiguous output buffer at unaff_EBX, unrolled 4-at-a-time, matching the shape of the buffer later passed to FUN_004ec940 as message 0x22's payload in FUN_004ebf50.
results.summary: Flattens all registered dynamic parameters' current values into a contiguous array for network transmission.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_format_values
results.evidence: For each registered entry, copies its name string into the output buffer, appends a space, then sprintf's the corresponding value from param_1 (a decoded values array) as "%d\n" or "%f\n" depending on the entry's type flag.
results.summary: Formats a decoded array of parameter values back into "name value" text lines, used after receiving a parameters-protocol update.

results.name: message_delta_protocol_initialize
results.evidence: Conditionally reloads parameters.cfg (FUN_004ebda0), resets a 0x18-byte-stride array of flags from DAT_0069a304 to DAT_0069a5a4 to 1, and calls FUN_004ec790 (layout size computation) for every message descriptor from PTR_DAT_0065d440 up to 0x65d520.
results.summary: Initializes the message-delta protocol subsystem: reloads config, resets per-message flags, and computes each message type's layout size.

results.name: message_delta_parameters_protocol_dump_to_config_file
results.evidence: Matches naming-hint evidence (strings ['parameters.cfg']): calls FUN_004ec750, zeroes the DAT_0069a304..DAT_0069a5a4 flag array, and when DAT_0071cfa8 is set opens "parameters.cfg" for writing, fprintf's the built DAT_00860b40 text buffer, closes the file, and frees registrations via message_delta_parameters_protocol_free_registered.
results.summary: Writes the current formatted parameter values out to parameters.cfg and tears down the registration table.

results.name: message_delta_field_bindings_shutdown
results.evidence: Iterates every message descriptor in PTR_DAT_0065d440 calling FUN_004ec700 twice per entry; FUN_004ec700 dispatches a per-field-type vtable call at DAT_0069a2fc, consistent with a teardown pass over field bindings.
results.summary: Runs a teardown pass over every message type's field bindings, invoking each field type's cleanup callback twice per descriptor.

results.name: message_delta_metrics_dump
results.evidence: Matches naming-hint strings 'message metrics' and 'Message Summary.txt' (referenced globals/format) plus the literal print "Wrote network message metrics to %s"; builds a destination path via __snprintf("%s\\%s %s", "message metrics", DAT_0069b24c, <filename>) and logs completion via FUN_00496a80.
results.summary: Builds the output path for a network-message-metrics dump and logs a confirmation that it was written.

results.name: message_delta_encode_message_simple
results.evidence: Thin wrapper forwarding directly to FUN_004ec940 with a single-item array and flag derived from (param_2!=0), i.e. a convenience call for encoding a message with no changed-array iteration.
results.summary: Convenience wrapper that builds a message-delta message for a single value via message_delta_encode_message.

results.name: message_delta_decode_message_begin
results.evidence: Computes the current bit offset, calls FUN_004ece70 (message-delta header decode) and, on success, stores the returned bit length, the offset, and the bitstream context into an output continuation-state structure (in_EAX[3..6]) for further decoding, returning 1; otherwise advances the bitstream and returns 0.
results.summary: Begins decoding a message-delta message by reading its header and preparing continuation state for further field decoding.

results.name: message_delta_decode_array_field
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004ed070 (an array/whole-object decode helper) and, based on its result and a descriptor's element-count check, either advances the bitstream (failure) or marks the field decoded (piVar2[3]+=length, flag byte set), paralleling FUN_004ec490's single-field pattern.
results.summary: Decodes one array-typed message-delta field, advancing the running bit-length total on success.

results.name: message_delta_struct_field_decode
results.evidence: Called from 51 sites (consistent with being assigned as a generic per-field-type vtable+0x54 decode callback); forwards to FUN_004ed1d0 (read changed sub-fields) and, if nothing changed, rewinds the bitstream and returns 0, else marks the containing record's changed-flag byte and returns 1.
results.summary: Decodes a compound (multi-subfield) message-delta field by reading which of its sub-fields changed.

results.name: message_delta_struct_field_decode_forced
results.evidence: Same structure as FUN_004ec590 but takes an extra param_1 flag that, when nonzero, forces the field to be treated as changed even when FUN_004ed1d0 reports zero changed sub-fields.
results.summary: Variant of the compound field decoder that can be forced to treat the field as changed regardless of sub-field results.

results.name: message_delta_struct_field_decode_buffered
results.evidence: Same structure as FUN_004ec590 but passes a local 2048-byte stack buffer into FUN_004ed1d0 as an extra argument when the top-level type is not 1, suggesting a variant that stages decoded bytes through a scratch buffer.
results.summary: Variant of the compound field decoder that stages decoded sub-field data through a local scratch buffer.

results.name: message_delta_field_bindings_process
results.evidence: Iterates a *unaff_EBX-count array of 4-dword records, stopping at an all-zero sentinel, and for each calls a function pointer selected by field-type index from the vtable table at DAT_0069a2fc.
results.summary: Iterates a message type's field-binding list, invoking each field's type-specific callback until a sentinel entry is reached.

results.name: message_delta_field_bindings_reset
results.evidence: Iterates every message descriptor in PTR_DAT_0065d440, calling FUN_004ec900 twice per descriptor and clearing a byte at offset 0x18, consistent with resetting/destroying field-type initialization state before a config reload.
results.summary: Resets every message type's field-binding initialization state, invoking each field type's teardown callback.

results.name: message_delta_field_layout_compute_size
results.evidence: Sums per-sub-binding sizes (field+0x5c) across two binding lists (unaff_ESI+10 and *unaff_ESI[7]) plus a base type size from PTR_DAT_0065d440[...]+0x20, combines them with a protocol-version-dependent header size (7 or 10 based on DAT_0071cfa8) and a per-count bit-width lookup from DAT_0065d51f, storing the resulting totals into the descriptor.
results.summary: Computes and caches a message type's total encoded size (header, static fields, and array fields) for later use during encode/decode.

results.name: message_delta_field_bindings_init_types
results.evidence: For each field-binding entry not yet initialized (byte at +0x19), calls a create/init vtable slot at DAT_0069a2fc and a size-query vtable slot at DAT_0069a2f8, storing the resulting size and marking the entry initialized.
results.summary: Lazily initializes each not-yet-initialized field type used by a message's field bindings, caching its computed size.

results.name: message_delta_field_bindings_destroy_types
results.evidence: For each field-binding entry marked active, calls a destroy vtable slot at DAT_0069a300 and clears the active byte, mirroring the init done in FUN_004ec840.
results.summary: Tears down every previously-initialized field type in a message's field bindings.

results.name: message_delta_encode_message
results.evidence: Called from 58 sites across this batch (build_local_player_position_update, build_local_player_vehicle_update, FUN_004e7890/84d0/86f0/7d90/ebf50, etc.) each passing a message-type id (0x22-0x2a); writes a header via FUN_004ecd00, initializes per-item context via FUN_004ecb60, and encodes fields for each of param_6 items via FUN_004ecc00, returning the encoded bit length.
results.prototype: int __cdecl message_delta_encode_message(int flag, int message_type, int changed_offset, void **items, int type_offset, int count, char force_changed)
results.summary: Central message-delta encoder: builds the header and per-item field data for a given network message type over an array of items.

results.name: message_delta_encode_init_item_context
results.evidence: Initializes bit-offset bookkeeping fields (0x40-0x7c) in the message-encode context (in_EAX) differently depending on whether *(in_EAX+8)==1, computing header/type sizes from PTR_DAT_0065d440.
results.summary: Initializes per-item bit-offset state within the message-delta encode context before encoding an item's fields.

results.name: message_delta_encode_all_fields
results.evidence: First encodes a message type's static (non-array) fields via each field's vtable+0x50 callback, then loops calling FUN_004ecde0 per field index, combining the changed-flags with different AND/OR logic depending on *(in_EAX+8)==1.
results.summary: Encodes all static and per-field data for one message item, aggregating whether any field changed.

results.name: message_delta_encode_message_header
results.evidence: Writes a 'has data' bit via bit_stream_write_bit and, when DAT_0071cfa8 (a protocol-version flag) is set, writes an additional sequence bit, accumulating written bit counts via FUN_004cf8f0.
results.summary: Writes the leading header bit(s) of a message-delta message, varying by protocol version.

results.name: message_delta_encode_field
results.evidence: Invokes a single field's vtable+0x50 encode callback, writes a changed-bit via bit_stream_write_bit when the item's type flag (unaff_ESI+8)==1, accumulates the bit count into unaff_ESI+0x44, and records the changed flag into DAT_006b89c0[param_1].
results.summary: Encodes one top-level message field via its type-specific callback and records whether it changed.

results.name: message_delta_decode_message_header
results.evidence: Decode-side counterpart to FUN_004ecd00: reads the 'has data' bit, a type index bounded to 0-0x37, an optional protocol-version-dependent bit/count when DAT_0071cfa8 is set, and a per-descriptor bit-width from DAT_0065d51f indexed by the message's field count.
results.summary: Decodes the header of a message-delta message, including its type index and field-count bit width, mirroring the encoder.

results.name: message_delta_decode_field_or_all_unchanged
results.evidence: No unaff_ registers are used (clean explicit param_1), unlike its siblings; when the descriptor's flag is 0, either fast-paths filling the buffer with an all-unchanged marker (0x01010101) or reads per-bit changed flags via bit_stream_read_bit, then optionally calls FUN_004ed290 for static sub-fields before copying the decoded flags into DAT_006b89c0.
results.summary: Decodes per-sub-field changed flags for a field (or shortcuts to 'all unchanged'), then reads any associated static sub-field data.

results.name: message_delta_read_changed_subfields
results.evidence: Iterates a field's sub-binding array (base+0x28, stride 0x10), and for each sub-field whose changed-flag byte (param_1[i]) is nonzero, calls that sub-field's decode callback via vtable+0x54, accumulating the returned bit length or returning 0 on any failure.
results.summary: Reads only the sub-fields marked as changed within a compound message-delta field, invoking each sub-field's decode callback.

results.name: message_delta_read_static_subfields
results.evidence: Iterates a descriptor's static-field list (base+0x1c) calling each field's decode callback via vtable+0x54 unconditionally, accumulating bit length, used by FUN_004ed070 for a message's always-present fields.
results.summary: Decodes all of a message type's unconditional (non-optional) static fields.

results.name: message_delta_decode_dispatch
results.evidence: Trivial one-line forwarder to FUN_004ed390 (outside this batch), giving no further evidence of its own beyond acting as an entry point into the decode pipeline.
results.summary: Thin forwarding function into the message-delta decode pipeline.
